paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +1.05% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+3.30%) and FTSE 100 weakest (+0.32%). Brent crude changed -0.11% to 102.2. Gold changed -0.80% to 4,168.6001. Bitcoin changed +0.43% to 85,214.9766. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.266%, a relative move of +0.55%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (+3.64%) and Glencore (+2.95%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: EG Group delays IPO plans and draws takeover interest (FT Markets). Petrol station empire had filed for New York listing aiming to raise about $1bn at $9bn valuation Deals and capital markets: Goldman bought Shein shares worth $220mn after dismal IPO (FT Markets). Shares in fast-fashion retailer have tumbled 38% since listing in Hong Kong last month Central banks and macro: Eurozone inflation hits three-year high of 3.8% (FT World). Consumer prices rose at higher rate than expected in September Central banks and macro: Quant hedge funds reap big gains from global bond sell-off (FT World). Trend-following portfolios have latched on to sharp rise in yields this year as Iran war and strong US economic data fuel inflation fears Geopolitics and trade: PM warned Rosebank oil field could breach West Bank sanctions (BBC Business). Campaigners and Green Party leader Zack Polanski raise concerns about Rosebank's ties to an Israeli firm.
